comment: The renderer's `environment` payload (the TRON grid, spike/include/xr/ipc.hpp EnvironmentPayload). The renderer's decoder (spike/tests/environment_test.cpp) and the supervisor's frame builder (tools/native_spike/environment.py, tests/native_spike/test_environment.py) both run over this file. Each valid entry gives the decoded colour (0 cyan, 1 theme).
